$comment: Every element of a terminal and of a shell that a look must decide, as look.json elements["<tool>.<element>"] = { "choice": what it will be, "why": the user need from brief.md it serves }, or "keep" (the user's current one stays). A choice of "none" also needs a why. A tool.json lists elementsOmit for elements the tool cannot change.

terminal.color-scheme: 16 ANSI colors, foreground, background, bold and dim
terminal.font: font family, fallback for icons (Nerd Font symbols), weight
terminal.cursor: shape, color, blink, text under it
terminal.padding: space between text and window edge
terminal.background: solid color, image, gradient or animation behind the text
terminal.opacity: window transparency and blur (acrylic, mica, vibrancy)
terminal.effects: shaders and retro effects (CRT, scanlines, glow)
terminal.window-frame: title bar and border colors, decorations, rounded corners
terminal.window-icon: the app icon in the taskbar, dock or launcher (a shortcut or .desktop icon)
terminal.window-title: what the title bar or window list shows
terminal.tab-row: tab bar background and position, shown or hidden
terminal.tab-style: active and inactive tab colors, shape, close buttons
terminal.tab-title: what each tab shows (folder, running command, fixed name)
terminal.tab-icon: the icon on each tab or profile
terminal.profiles: names and order of profiles and the new-tab menu
terminal.scrollbar: shown, hidden or overlay, and its color
terminal.unfocused: how unfocused panes and windows look (dimmed, cursor)
terminal.bell: audible, visual flash, taskbar badge or none
terminal.startup-layout: window size and position, startup tabs and split panes
terminal.keybindings: keys for tabs, splits, copy and paste, quake window
terminal.shell-integration: prompt marks, jump between commands, open in same folder
terminal.links: clickable URLs and file paths and their style
terminal.behavior: options: copy on select, paste warnings, close confirmation, word delimiters, right-click
terminal.responsiveness: how the layout adapts to window and pane size: panes that collapse or hide on small windows, minimum sizes

shell.prompt: the main prompt: layout, segments, colors, glyphs
shell.right-prompt: a right-aligned prompt part (time, duration, status)
shell.transient-prompt: how past prompts collapse in scrollback
shell.continuation-prompt: the prompt for unfinished multi-line input
shell.window-title: the title the shell sets (folder, running command)
shell.banner: what shows when a new tab opens (fetch, art, nothing)
shell.syntax-colors: colors of commands, arguments, strings and errors while typing
shell.autosuggestions: inline history suggestions and their color
shell.completion-menu: tab completion menu style and colors
shell.ls-colors: colors and icons of files and folders (LS_COLORS, eza, lsd)
shell.grep-colors: match and file name colors in grep and ripgrep
shell.fuzzy-finder: fzf or similar picker colors and layout
shell.pager: less, man pages and bat colors
shell.git-colors: git status, diff and log colors (delta, git pager)
shell.responsiveness: how prompt and banner adapt to narrow panes: shorter path, fewer segments, banner hidden
